exitCriteria.title: Median correction resolution time is inside the section 14.3 service levels
exitCriteria.reason: The aggregate-only calculator is locally implemented, but there are no real production correction cases, quarterly metrics, or observed service-level result. Illustrative cases explicitly cannot produce publishable metrics.

exitCriteria.title: No unresolved critical correction at launch
exitCriteria.reason: No real beta correction intake or operated case register exists. A local empty or illustrative collection is not evidence that no critical correction remains unresolved at launch. On 2026-10-28 docs/CORRECTIONS_WORKFLOW.md documented an optional correction email route, shown only when the owner sets CORRECTIONS_RECIPIENT_EMAIL at build time. It states that a received email opens no production case and starts no service clock, and it names no recipient, so it still claims no live intake or real cases; the digest was refreshed, and this reason still holds.

exitCriteria.title: The quarterly reproducibility test passes
exitCriteria.reason: A seeded owner-run harness now draws from a checksum-bound population manifest and records every sampled unit's recomputation pass or fail. Its checked-in population is synthetic test data only. The admitted federal electoral output remains a single prior reproduction, and no published-production population manifest or owner-run quarterly result exists. The controlling quarterly criterion therefore remains unsatisfied. externalBlockers.reason: Every applicable Phase 0–8 gate must pass for any surface proposed for public beta or launch; the technical preview is not an exception.
Actual invitations, public deployment, production admission, and launch require explicit owner authorization at the moment of each action.
Real participant support, correction handling, remediation, and the first quarterly aggregate metrics must be operated and evidenced before this phase can pass.
At least one source agency must review its own admitted data as presented and confirm it; no outreach or confirmation is represented by this local record.

nonProductionBoundary: The existing ChatGPT-hosted site is a technical preview with illustrative data. This local preparation sends no invitation, contacts no agency, accepts no production data, publishes no correction metric, and makes no beta, deployment, or launch claim.
